name: Real MXN
oneLiner: MXNe is Brale's Mexican peso stablecoin issued in partnership with Etherfuse, backed by Etherfuse Stablebonds (CETES exposure) on Base, Solana, and Stellar.
collateral: Backed by Etherfuse CETES Stablebonds — short-duration (~7-day) Mexican federal government Treasury bills (CETES), held across regulated Mexican custodians with a majority at BBVA Mexico and held through INDEVAL; reserves segregated from Etherfuse corporate funds, issued via Brale's regulated US stack
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption through Brale onboarding, with MXNe intended to remain redeemable 1:1 for the equivalent value of Mexican pesos and usable for payments, remittances, and payroll

proofOfReserves.provider: Etherfuse third-party attestations (BHR Mexico) covering the CETES Stablebonds backing MXNe

jurisdiction.license: Money Services Business / Money Transmitter, NMLS ID #2376957

genius.licensingRegulator: FinCEN / state money transmitter regulators; NMLS ID #2376957
genius.notes: MXNe is a Brale-issued peso stablecoin with U.S. money-transmitter context, but no GENIUS permitted-issuer approval or official application was located. Brale operates as a FinCEN-registered MSB and licensed money transmitter (NMLS #2376957). The June 2026 Visa/Brale SBC proof-of-concept on Canton Network does not change MXNe's GENIUS status. Brale has not announced a PPSI pathway election (state-qualified vs. federal nonbank) as of 2026-06-07.

mintAuthority.summary: MXNe is issued by Brale (FinCEN MSB / state money transmitter) in partnership with Etherfuse; approved businesses mint and redeem 1:1 directly from their Brale accounts against CETES-backed reserves, so supply creation runs entirely through the issuer's permissioned backend.

controls.label: Brale issuance backend
controls.evidence: Brale mints and burns MXNe for KYC-onboarded businesses minting/redeeming 1:1 with USDC/USDP directly in Brale accounts; issuance is fully permissioned by the issuer with no open mint route.

review.evidence: Brale (registered MSB, NMLS #2376957) operates the centralized mint/redeem for MXNe across Base, Solana, and Stellar, backed by Etherfuse CETES stablebonds; only Brale-onboarded businesses can mint/redeem, so supply is issuer-controlled with no permissionless route. On-chain mint authority not independently read.
unresolvedQuestions: Read the on-chain minter/owner role on Base and the Solana/Stellar mint authorities to confirm Brale control before raising confidence.
